component.name: OpenExtract
component.summary: Get your texts off an iPhone backup and search them

description.p: Getting your text messages off an iPhone is harder than it should be. OpenExtract opens an iPhone backup on your own computer and lets you read, search and save everything in it: messages and iMessages, photos, voicemails, contacts, call history and notes.
It is free with no strings attached. There is no account, no trial and no paid tier, and nothing you open is ever uploaded. This Flatpak has no network access at all.

ul.li: Read whole conversations as chat bubbles, with photos
Search inside a conversation, and find conversations by name
Save a conversation as a PDF, with its photos
Export conversations as HTML, CSV or plain text
Save voicemails as audio files and photos as ordinary image files
Opens encrypted backups with the backup password

screenshot.caption: Everything in the backup at a glance
Voicemails you can play and save

description.p: Send feedback or report a problem from inside the app: the report is filled in with the app and phone details, with personal details left out, and opens in your browser for you to check and send. The app also says right away when its engine stops, instead of waiting with no message.

Calls from other apps show readable names, numbers saved in a local format match international ones, and older call history formats load. Text fields no longer download spell-check dictionaries, and the app has its own icon.
Save a conversation as a PDF, with its photos. Photo counts now cover only the photos in the backup, and exports say what a message without text is.
